school.name: High School for Law, Advocacy and Community Justice
school.overview: At the HS for Law, Advocacy and Community Justice our mission is to emP.O.W.E.R. our students to be productive citizens through challenging academic curricula, rich-meaningful experiences and partnerships, positioning them to be successful beyond high school. Our students are immersed in the study, inquiry, and advocacy of law, with required involvement in community service, thus enabling them to realize their individual potential throughout the greater community. Students in our Early College Prep program take Dual Enrollment courses (College courses) during the regular school day and earn at least six FREE college credits in addition to College NOW courses available through our partnership with John Jay College of Criminal Justice.
school.subway: 1 to 66th St-Lincoln Center; 2, 3 to 72nd St; A, B, C, D to 59th St-Columbus Circle

programs.name: Law, Advocacy and Community Justice High School (M14A)
programs.description: Students take law courses in their 10th, 11th and 12th grade years in addition to their social studies courses; a college preparatory focus is incorporated into the curriculum.

programs.name: Early College Preparatory Program (M14B)
programs.description: In conjunction with John Jay College of Criminal Justice, our College Preparatory Program offers students access to earn multiple college credits in high school. College courses are offered at the school during the school day, after school as well as at the college campus. Credits earned with John Jay College will be transferable to any college that accepts CUNY transfer credits.
